name: Harukanaru Thule e no Tabibito
original_name: 遥かなるトゥーレへの旅人
source:
You are traveling Iceland alone.
In the far a way wilderness, you encounter a mysterious hitchhiker girl.
I felt danger in the strange atmosphere, but you decided to give her a ride.
From then on, strange and strange things start to happen around you.

Will you be able to finish your journey safely and return home alive?
Traveling around Iceland ADV "A Traveler to unknown Thule"
Life or death depends on you.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2154380/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你獨自旅行於冰島。
在偏遠的荒野中，你遇見一位神秘的搭便車女孩。
古怪的氣氛讓你感到危險，你卻還是決定載她一程。
從此，你身邊開始發生一件又一件離奇的事。

你能平安完成旅程，活著回家嗎？
環遊冰島的冒險遊戲《A Traveler to unknown Thule》。
生死由你決定。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2154380/]Steam[/url]]
